ऐरावणः (see ऐरावत below)
Indra's elephant (produced at the
churning of the ocean).

ऐरावतः [इरा आपः तद्वान् इरावान्
समुद्रः तस्मादुत्पन्नः अण्]
1 N. of the
elephant of Indra.
--2 An excellent
elephant.
--3 One of the chiefs
of the Nāgas or serpent-race
(inhabiting Pātāla).
--4 The
elephant presiding over the east.
--5 A kind of rainbow.
--6 A kind
of lightning; (said to be n. also in
these two senses).
--7 The orange
tree.
--तं
1 A vast and waterless
region.
--2 (pl.) N. of a Varṣa.
--3 N.
of the northern path of the moon.
--ती
1 The female of Indra's
elephant.
--2 Lightning.
--3 N. of
a plant (वटपत्री).
--4 N. of the river
Rāvī in the Panjāba (= इरावती).
--5
N. of a particular portion of the
moon's path.
